method: One boolean spike per tick bounds the exponentially filtered rate by 1/dt from its zero initialization. Thus exp(-homeostasis_rate * elapsed_seconds * max(1/dt - maximum_rate, 0)) is a conservative homeostasis-only retained-weight factor, ignoring finite precision. Counts below 1% are far beyond this bound. This excludes homeostasis alone, not indirect interactions or different learning terms. Only initially positive weights within the maximum bound are counted.
